Rolling and longitudinal seam welding

jobs.occupation: SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN? - ARE YOU READY TO JOIN THE JOURNEY?
jobs.description:
SKAL DU MED PÅ REJSEN?

RenTid søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent med ambitioner

RenTid er en virksomhed i vækst, og vi søger en erfaren rengøringsassistent, som både er dygtig til sit håndværk og har lyst til at udvikle sig.

Måske har du mange års erfaring med rengøring. Måske har du arbejdet i private hjem, hos erhvervskunder, med kvalitetssikring eller koordinering. Eller måske ved du bare, at du kan mere, end du får mulighed for at vise i dit nuværende job.

Så kan RenTid være stedet for dig.

⚠️ EN VIGTIG TING, DU SKAL VIDE

Hos RenTid starter alle på gulvet.

Du bliver ansat som rengøringsassistent – ikke som leder, supervisor eller direktør.

Du starter sammen med alle andre, ude hos kunderne og med rengøringen i hænderne.

Vi er ikke så optagede af din titel eller hvad der står på dit CV. Vi vil se:

• 
Hvad du kan

• 
Hvordan du arbejder

• 
Din indstilling og arbejdsmoral

• 
Hvordan du behandler kunder og kollegaer

• 
Om du tager ansvar

• 
Om du har det, der skal til for at vokse med RenTid

 HVOR KAN DET FØRE DIG HEN?

Det ved vi ikke på forhånd. Det afhænger af dig.

Når RenTid vokser, opstår nye muligheder. Den rigtige medarbejder kan derfor med tiden få mere ansvar, eksempelvis:

• 
Ansvar for bestemte kunder

• 
Kvalitetskontrol

• 
Oplæring af nye medarbejdere

• 
Koordinering af kollegaer

• 
Planlægning af opgaver

• 
Kundekontakt

• 
Ansvar for bestemte områder

• 
Teamlederfunktioner

• 
Driftsansvar

• 
På længere sigt endnu større ansvar i virksomheden

Mulighederne er mange, hvis du viser, at du er klar til dem.

Vi vil gerne finde en person, som på sigt kan blive en central del af RenTid. Men større ansvar, højere løn og flere goder følger med det, du viser, du kan løfte.

 DU STARTER MED EN GOD LØN

Vi tilbyder en god og ordentlig løn fra starten.

Men vi er også ærlige: Du starter ikke på en direktørløn.

Som rengøringsassistent får du ikke automatisk lederansvar, højere løntrin, fri firmabil, fri telefon eller andre goder, der følger med større ansvar.

Det arbejder man sig frem til.

Når du tager ansvar, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte en større rolle, følger mulighederne med.

 DINE OPGAVER

Du skal først og fremmest kunne det vigtigste:

Rengøring.

Du kommer til at arbejde hos vores kunder i Aarhus og omegn, både private hjem og erhvervskunder.

Du skal kunne arbejde professionelt og selvstændigt og forstå, at vores kunder forventer et resultat, de kan være stolte af.

Hos RenTid skal rengøring ikke bare overstås.

Det skal gøres ordentligt.

Du skal have øje for detaljerne, tage ansvar og sætte en ære i at levere et resultat, der lever op til RenTids standarder.

 HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG?

Vi forventer ikke, at du er perfekt. Men vi forventer, at du vil blive bedre.

Du skal:

• 
Være mødestabil og fleksibel

• 
Have en positiv attitude

• 
Have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

• 
Kunne arbejde selvstændigt og i team

• 
Have øje for detaljer

• 
Sætte en ære i et perfekt resultat

• 
Tage ansvar for dine opgaver

• 
Kunne modtage og bruge feedback konstruktivt

• 
Være loyal over for kunder, kollegaer og RenTid

• 
Være løsningsorienteret

• 
Kunne bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

• 
Have kørekort kategori B

• 
Selv kunne komme til og fra arbejdspladsen i Aarhus

• 
Være indforstået med, at der kan forekomme weekendarbejde

• 
Tale, forstå, læse, og skrive Engelsk 

Har du ikke kørekort B, eller ønsker du ikke at køre bil, er stillingen ikke den rette for dig.

⭐ ERFARING ER VIGTIGT

Vi søger en person med stor erfaring inden for rengøring i private hjem. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er det ikke dig, vi søger.

Erfaring med erhvervsrengøring er en klar fordel.

Du skal kende de grundlæggende principper inden for professionel rengøring og kunne arbejde effektivt uden at gå på kompromis med kvaliteten.

Hos RenTid skærer vi ikke hjørnerne. Vi gør tingene ordentligt.

Men erfaring alene er ikke nok.

Vi leder også efter:

Mindset. Arbejdsmoral. Ansvar. Vilje. Drive.

Du skal have lyst til at blive bedre – og lyst til at blive mere.

⏱️ DE FØRSTE 3 MÅNEDER

De første 3 måneder er en prøveperiode i henhold til gældende danske regler.

Det er en periode, hvor både du og vi finder ud af, om vi er det rigtige match.

Vi ser blandt andet på:

• 
Hvordan du møder på arbejde

• 
Hvordan du arbejder

• 
Hvordan du behandler kunder

• 
Hvordan du fungerer med kollegaer

• 
Hvordan du reagerer på feedback

• 
Om du tager ansvar

• 
Om du har lyst til at lære

• 
Om du har det drive, vi leder efter

Hvis svaret er ja, kan de første tre måneder blive begyndelsen på noget langt større.

 HOS RеNTID KAN DU UDVIKLE DIG

Vi tror på, at mennesker kan udvikle sig.

Derfor vil vi hellere finde den rigtige person med det rigtige mindset end den flotteste titel på CV'et.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan blive leder.

Vis os det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du kan tage ansvar.

Tag det.

Du behøver ikke fortælle os, at du har ambitioner.

Vis dem.

 HVIS DU VIL MERE...

Vi kan ikke love dig en lederstilling om seks måneder, en firmabil om et år eller en direktørløn.

Det skal du gøre dig fortjent til.

Men vi kan love dig dette:

Hvis du arbejder hårdt, tager ansvar, udvikler dig, skaber resultater og viser, at du kan løfte mere, så vil vi gerne give dig mulighederne for at vokse.

For når RenTid vokser, skal vores medarbejdere have mulighed for at vokse med.

Her starter alle på gulvet. Hvor langt du kan komme derfra, afhænger i høj grad af dig.

 ARBEJDSOMRÅDE

Stillingen er primært i Aarhus og omegn.

Du skal kunne transportere dig til og fra arbejdspladsen og være indstillet på, at arbejdsdagen kan foregå hos forskellige kunder.

RenTid stiller bil til rådighed for dig eller teamet i arbejdstiden.

 LYDER DET SOM DIG?

Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send os en ansøgning og dit CV med billede, hvor du fortæller:

• 
Hvem du er

• 
Hvor længe du har arbejdet med rengøring

• 
Din erfaring med private hjem

• 
Eventuel erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

• 
Hvad du gerne vil udvikle dig inden for

• 
Hvorfor du passer godt ind hos RenTid

Skriv gerne din ansøgning på Engelsk  Mærk ansøgningen "The Journey".

"Jeg skal med på rejsen"

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

 JOIN US ON THE JOURNEY!

RenTid is looking for an experienced cleaner with ambition

RenTid is a growing company, and we are looking for an experienced cleaner who is highly skilled at their profession and wants to develop further.

Perhaps you have many years of experience in cleaning, private homes, commercial cleaning, quality control or coordination. Or perhaps you simply know that you have more to offer than you currently get the opportunity to show.

Then RenTid might be the right place for you.

⚠️ ONE IMPORTANT THING YOU NEED TO KNOW

At RenTid, everyone starts on the floor.

You will be hired as a cleaner – not as a manager, supervisor or director.

You start alongside everyone else, working directly with our customers and the cleaning itself.

We are less interested in titles and more interested in seeing:

• 
What you can do

• 
How you work

• 
Your attitude and work ethic

• 
How you treat customers and colleagues

• 
Whether you take responsibility

• 
Whether you have what it takes to grow with RenTid

 WHERE CAN THIS JOURNEY TAKE YOU?

We don't know in advance.

That depends on you.

As RenTid grows, new opportunities will arise. The right person can gradually take on more responsibility, such as:

• 
Responsibility for specific customers

• 
Quality control

• 
Training new employees

• 
Coordinating colleagues

• 
Planning tasks

• 
Customer communication

• 
Responsibility for specific areas

• 
Team leader responsibilities

• 
Operational responsibility

• 
Greater responsibility within the company over time

There are many opportunities if you show that you are ready for them.

Greater responsibility, higher salary and additional benefits come with what you demonstrate that you can handle.

 YOU START WITH A GOOD SALARY

We offer a good and fair salary from day one.

But we are also honest: You will not start on a director's salary.

Management responsibility, higher salary levels, private use of a company car, company phone and other benefits are not automatic.

They are things you work your way towards.

As you take responsibility and deliver results, the opportunities will follow.

 YOUR INITIAL ROLE

First and foremost, you need to be able to do the most important thing:

Clean.

You will work at customer locations in Aarhus and the surrounding areas, including private homes and commercial clients.

You must be able to work professionally and independently and understand that our customers expect a result they can be proud of.

At RenTid, cleaning is not something to rush through.

It has to be done properly.

You should have an eye for detail, take responsibility and take pride in meeting RenTid's standards.

 WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

We don't expect you to be perfect. But we expect you to want to become better.

You must:

• 
Be reliable and flexible

• 
Have a positive attitude

• 
Be willing to learn and develop

• 
Work independently and as part of a team

• 
Have an eye for detail

• 
Take pride in delivering a perfect result

• 
Take responsibility for your work

• 
Receive and use feedback constructively

• 
Be loyal to customers, colleagues and RenTid

• 
Be solution-oriented

• 
Maintain an overview in a busy environment

• 
Have a valid Category B driving licence

• 
Be able to get to and from work in Aarhus independently

• 
Be comfortable with possible weekend work

• 
Speak, understand, read, and write English 

If you do not have a Category B licence or do not want to drive, this position is not for you.

⭐ EXPERIENCE MATTERS

We are looking for someone with extensive experience cleaning private homes. If you do not have this experience, this position is not for you.

Experience with commercial cleaning is a clear advantage.

You should already understand professional cleaning principles and be able to work efficiently without compromising quality.

At RenTid, we don't cut corners. We do things properly.

Experience alone is not enough.

We are also looking for:

Mindset. Work ethic. Responsibility. Determination. Drive.

You must want to become better – and want to become more.

⏱️ THE FIRST 3 MONTHS

The first 3 months are a probationary period in accordance with applicable Danish employment law.

This is a period where both you and RenTid can determine whether we are the right match.

We will look at:

• 
How you show up for work

• 
How you work

• 
How you treat customers

• 
How you work with colleagues

• 
How you respond to feedback

• 
Whether you take responsibility

• 
Whether you want to learn

• 
Whether you have the drive we are looking for

If the answer is yes, these first three months could be the beginning of something much bigger.

 AT RENTID, YOU CAN DEVELOP

We believe people can develop.

That is why we would rather find the right person with the right mindset than the person with the most impressive title on their CV.

You don't need to tell us you can become a manager.

Show us.

You don't need to tell us you can take responsibility.

Take it.

You don't need to tell us you have ambition.

Show us.

 IF YOU WANT MORE...

We cannot promise you a management position in six months, a company car in a year or a director's salary.

You have to earn it.

But we can promise you this:

If you work hard, take responsibility, develop yourself, deliver results and show that you can handle more, we want to give you opportunities to grow.

Because when RenTid grows, our employees should have the opportunity to grow with it.

Everyone starts on the floor. How far you go from there will largely depend on you.

 WORKING AREA

The position is primarily based in Aarhus and the surrounding areas.

You must be able to travel to and from work and be comfortable working at different customer locations.

RenTid provides a car for you or your team during working hours.

 DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU?

Then we would love to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV with a photo, including:

• 
Who you are

• 
How long you have worked in cleaning

• 
Your experience with private homes

• 
Any commercial cleaning experience

• 
What you would like to develop within

• 
Why you believe you would be a good fit for RenTid

Please write your application in English . Please mark your application: “The Journey”.

"I want to join the journey"

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

• 
Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

• 
Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

• 
Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

• 
Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

• 
Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

• 
A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

• 
A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

• 
Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

• 
A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

• 
A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

• 
The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

• 
Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

• 
Prior research and publication experience.

• 
Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

• 
Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

• 
Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

• 
Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

• 
Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

• 
A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

• 
The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

• 
Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

• 
Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

• 
Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level
jobs.description:
Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  We are offering a PhD fellowship in Artificial Intelligence for Monitoring and Decision Support at Animal and Herd Level commencing 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible hereafter.

  Our group and research
 The hired PhD student will join the research group Data & Modelling which currently has 9 members, including one research assistant, two PhD students, and 6 associate professors. Our research group is focused advanced methods for monitoring and modelling data from animal production systems. This includes the use of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods. 

  Project description
 The PhD project will be focused on developing, assessing, and comparing traditional and modern ML and AI methods in terms of their utility and practicality for monitoring diverse types of time series data recorded at the levels of herds, groups of animals, and individual animals. The project will be based on already available data sets, and the collection of new data is not expected to be a part of this project.

  The data sets will include

   	
• Herd level input and production data with the aims of estimating e.g. infection status or environmental impact 	
• Sensor data record on or around individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns 	
• Video data recorded of individuals or groups of animals with the aim of classifying health status or behaviour patterns   The ML/AI methods will include

   	
• Traditional time series modelling, specifically dynamic linear models (a type of state space model) 	
• Neural network-based time series models, specifically transformers 	
• Convolutional neural networks, for encoding video frames 	
• Closed frontier large language models (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini) 	
• Small open weights models to be run locally (e.g. Qwen3.5-9B, OpenAI gpt-oss-20b, Mistral Ministral 3 8B Reasoning)   The exact combinations of data sets and methods will depend on the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

  Principal supervisor is Associate professor Dan Børge Jensen, Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, daj@sund.ku.dk, Direct Phone: +4535333021.

  Duration: 3 years as a PhD student + 3 months as research assistant for enrolment

  
 Job description
 Your key tasks as a PhD student at SUND are:

   	
• Carrying through an independent research project under supervision.    	
• Completing PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points. 	
• Participating in active research environments including a stay at another research team. 	
• Obtaining experience with teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project 	
• Teaching and disseminating your knowledge. 	
• Writing a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project   PhD Programme Description:
 The PhD programme is a three-year full-time research education within the framework of the 5+3 scheme, intended for candidates holding a relevant academic degree within the project’s subject area (e.g., Anima Science).

  Qualifications:
 If you have completed your academic education in Denmark, the admission to the PhD programme requires a relevant Master’s degree (equivalent to 180 ECTS BSc + 120 ECTS MSc).

  If you have an academic education from abroad, you must have either a degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree (180 ETCS + 120 ECTS MSc), or at a minimum, a bachelor’s degree equivalent to a Danish bachelor's degree (180 ECTS) and be academically qualified at master's level.

  As part of the assessment of whether you meet the educational requirements, you must also achieve a positive academic evaluation and be assessed as the best qualified for the position.

  The successful candidate should further be able to demonstrate the following:

   	
• Mastery of the R language for statistical computing 	
• Practical experience with the Keras and Tensorflow R packages 	
• Practical experience with state space models (e.g. dynamic linear models) for time series modelling 	
• Practical experience with training and evaluating fully connected artificial neural networks 	
• Practical experience with training and evaluating convolutional neural networks 	
• Practical experience with training and evaluating transformer neural networks 	
• Practical experience with the use of large language models via API calls   Other important criteria are:

   	
• The grade point average achieved 	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Previous publications 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other professional activities 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in machine learning and artificial intelligence. 	
• Language skills   Place of employment

  The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and modern computer hardware for training artificial neural networks.

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The employment is conditioned upon the applicant’s successful enrolment as a PhD student at the Graduate School at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant during an initial three-month employment as a research assistant.

  The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the Faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. 

  Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 27,800 DKK/Roughly 3,700 EUR (October 2021 level) plus pension.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD studies at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences is available at the Graduate School’s website: https://healthsciences.ku.dk/phd/guidelines/

  Application procedure
 Your application must be submitted electronically by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. The application must include the following documents in PDF format: 

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page)

  2. CV incl. education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position

  3. Certified copy of original Master of Science diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD fellowship employment, your master’s degree must be equivalent to a Danish master’s degree. We encourage you to read more in the assessment database: https://ufm.dk/en/education/recognition-and-transparency/find-assessments/assessment-database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science

  4. Publication list (if possible)

  Application deadline:  7 October 2026, 23.59pm CEST.

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor.

  The assessor makes a non-prioritized assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement.

  Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You find information about the recruitment process at: http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicants will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  Interviews are expected to be held in week 45 or 46.

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.
